CF_ORIG_PACIFIST_DESCRIPTION: Refuses to strike. Turns aggression back on the attacker and keeps the party standing.
CF_ORIG_TRAINER_DESCRIPTION: Never fights alone. Bonds with a partner beast and grows stronger with every victory.
CF_ORIG_VAMPIRIC_DESCRIPTION: Pays health to swing and drinks it back on contact. Punished for missing, unstoppable when it connects.
STATUS_CF_ENGORGED_DESCRIPTION: Swollen with stolen blood. +8 maximum health while it lasts.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_ARM_ORIG_STARTER_PACIFIS: A branch, offered rather than swung. Every one of its techniques stuns, weakens or shields - none of them deal a single point of damage.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_ARM_ORIG_STARTER_TRAINER: A carved whistle pitched for animal ears. Rallies allies and startles beasts.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_ARM_ORIG_STARTER_VAMPIRI: A thin, fluted blade that drinks as deeply as it cuts.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_ARM_ORIG_TRAINER_BALL_CH: A woven charm carrying your wolf partner's scent. Call it to a free space at your side.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_ARM_ORIG_TRAINER_BALL_EM: A charm kept warm by a captured ember. Call your fire elemental partner to a free space at your side.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_ARM_ORIG_TRAINER_BALL_RI: A charm carved from frost-cracked stone. Call your golem partner to a free space at your side.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_SKILL_CF_PACIFIST_CROUCH: At the end of your turn, gain Reflect for 2 turns. Reflect returns half of one incoming attack (minimum 1) to the attacker, then is used up. Once per round.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_SKILL_CF_PACIFIST_FIELD_: At the end of your turn, restore 4 health to the ally with the lowest percentage of health remaining. Once per round.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_SKILL_CF_PACIFIST_WHY_CA: Whenever you take damage, the attacker takes 30% of that damage back, up to a maximum of 12. Always triggers. Your weapon deals no damage at all, so this is how a Pacifist fights.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_SKILL_CF_TRAINER_BOND_ST: Each point of Bond adds +3% Awareness to every ability you declare, capping at +30% once your Bond reaches 10. Bond is built by Gotta Train 'Em.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_SKILL_CF_TRAINER_GOTTA_T: Every enemy you defeat raises your Bond by 1, to a maximum of 10. Bond feeds Bond Strength, and carries through the whole combat.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_SKILL_CF_TRAINER_TYPE_AD: On a PERFECT attack roll, 35% chance to afflict the target with Shock, Bleed, Poison or Resistance Down for 2 turns. Only PERFECT rolls can apply it, so accuracy is what makes this class work.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_SKILL_CF_VAMPIRIC_BAT_SW: Once you have gorged 3 times, the next enemy you slay rises again as a vampire bat that fights for you, and the count resets to 0. Once per round.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_SKILL_CF_VAMPIRIC_BLOOD_: Every hostile ability costs you 3 health. Always triggers, cannot be blocked or reduced by armour, and it is paid whether the attack hits or misses.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_SKILL_CF_VAMPIRIC_CRIMSO: Whenever you deal damage, you recover 25% of it as health, always at least 1. Always triggers. This is what pays back Blood Price, so connecting matters more than swinging often.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_SKILL_CF_VAMPIRIC_ENGORG: Draining while already at full health makes you Engorged: +8 maximum health for 3 turns, letting the drain carry you above your normal maximum. Once per round.
UI_TOOLTIP_CF_ORIG_PACIFIST_DESCRIPTION: Refuses to strike. Turns aggression back on the attacker and keeps the party standing.
UI_TOOLTIP_CF_ORIG_TRAINER_DESCRIPTION: Never fights alone. Bonds with a partner beast and grows stronger with every victory.
UI_TOOLTIP_CF_ORIG_VAMPIRIC_DESCRIPTION: Pays health to swing and drinks it back on contact. Punished for missing, unstoppable when it connects.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_SKILL_CF_TRAINER_CHAOS_1: At the start of combat your wolf partner joins you: a grey forest wolf. Which stage answers depends on your Bond, raised by every enemy your party fells. Bond 0-2 calls the first stage, 3-5 the second, 6 and above the last.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_SKILL_CF_TRAINER_CHAOS_2: At the start of combat your wolf partner joins you: a hellhound, its coat run through with fire. Which stage answers depends on your Bond, raised by every enemy your party fells. Bond 0-2 calls the first stage, 3-5 the second, 6 and above the last.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_SKILL_CF_TRAINER_CHAOS_3: At the start of combat your wolf partner joins you: a Chaos Wolf, burning violet and no longer quite of this world. Which stage answers depends on your Bond, raised by every enemy your party fells. Bond 0-2 calls the first stage, 3-5 the second, 6 and above the last.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_CF_TRAINER_SUMMON_CHAOS_: Calls your wolf to a free space on your side. It grows with your Bond: a forest wolf, then a hellhound, then a Chaos Wolf.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_CF_TRAINER_SUMMON_EMBER_: Calls a fire elemental to a free space on your side. It burns what it strikes, and at full growth scatters flame across several foes.
UI_ENCYCLOPEDIA_CF_TRAINER_SUMMON_RIME_A: Calls a golem to a free space on your side. Slow and heavily armoured; at full growth its blows freeze and stun.
